relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRP vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) mediates nociception and the release of calcitonin-gene-related peptides (CGRPs)

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP recruits immune cells and promotes bacterial clearance and reparative dentinogenesis

key_findings: Review: pulpal afferents are mostly myelinated TG neurons, ~30% (mouse) to ~50% (rat) CGRP+, with Nav1.8 and Piezo2 expressed in most Aδ pulpal nociceptors
TRPV1, TRPA1, TRPC5 and TRPM8 mediate pulpal nociception and are sensitized by inflammatory mediators in pulpitis
